description: a 3 A blade fuse from a car kit

reasons: F1 is a 5 A polyfuse in the design; the circuit peaks at 2.4 A, so a 3 A blade fuse would run near its rating.
Trip time, I2t and breaking capacity of the candidate could not be confirmed (no datasheet). Protective part: the answer is no.
A simulation check cannot settle whether a fuse still trips in a fault.
safety_notes: Use the 5 A polyfuse from the BOM or an exact equivalent.
